title: 亚马逊公司发债250亿美元押注AI基建信用评级稳如磐石
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Amazon is raising at least $25 billion in US bonds to fund its AI spending, which Bloomberg intelligence says could top $300 billion of CapEx next year.
segments.zh: 亚马逊计划通过发行至少250亿美元美国债券，为其AI支出提供资金。彭博智库预计，明年相关资本支出可能超过3000亿美元。

segments.en: Let's discuss with Bloomberg intelligence credit analyst Robert Schiffman and Bloomberg tech host Ed Lodlow.
segments.zh: 我们邀请彭博智库信用分析师罗伯特·希夫曼和彭博科技主持人埃德·洛德洛进行讨论。

segments.en: Robert, on this deal, every day, not every day, I'm exaggerating.
segments.zh: 罗伯特，关于这笔交易，几乎每天——当然不是每天，我夸张了——

segments.en: It feels like we have some hyper-scaler coming to this bond market and tapping it.
segments.zh: 感觉总有大型云服务商进入债券市场融资。

segments.en: And for the most part, maybe we put aside SpaceX, the market absorbs it.
segments.zh: 大多数情况下，也许除了SpaceX，市场都能消化。

segments.en: How far can these companies take it? How far can they increase their leverage before we start looking at things like credit downgrades?
segments.zh: 这些公司能走多远？杠杆率提高到什么程度才会引发信用评级下调？

segments.en: I think you better get used to having me on set, because we're going to see a lot more.
segments.zh: 我觉得你最好习惯我常来，因为我们会看到更多类似交易。

segments.en: Which is a treat. You could just ask. No, Robert.
segments.zh: 那是好事。你直接说就行。不，罗伯特。

segments.en: We have said this over and over again. The biggest hyper-scalers I would consider to be on the Mount Rushmore of Credit.
segments.zh: 我们反复强调，最大的超大规模云服务商堪称信用领域的总统山。

segments.en: These are AA and AAA names that have hundreds and hundreds of billions of capacity.
segments.zh: 它们都是AA和AAA级公司，拥有数千亿美元的融资空间。

segments.en: Somebody asked me this morning, what would it take to have one of these names go to junk?
segments.zh: 今早有人问我，这些公司要怎样才会被降级为垃圾债？

segments.en: You're talking a number that would be, I think, over a trillion dollars.
segments.zh: 那得是超过一万亿美元的规模。

segments.en: So I just think that what we're seeing here, supply continues to fall well behind demand.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，目前供给持续远落后于需求。

segments.en: Spending is going up. And the only way to spend is to borrow more money.
segments.zh: 支出在增加，而增加支出的唯一途径就是借更多钱。

segments.en: Do they borrow at fixed rates or what happens if the Fed does have to hike a few times?
segments.zh: 他们是借固定利率，还是如果美联储不得不加息几次会怎样？

segments.en: Yeah. Well, primarily, all this extended duration borrowing is all fixed.
segments.zh: 是的，这些长期借款基本都是固定利率。

segments.en: So now you're locking in costs for 10, 20, 40 years.
segments.zh: 所以现在你锁定了10年、20年、40年的成本。
